system.boundary: Build a physically causal tractor model for steady tillage with a hydrostatic continuously variable transmission.
engineering_objects: Build a physically causal tractor model for steady tillage with a hydrostatic continuously variable transmission.

The model must include an engine or governed prime mover, a variable-displacement hydraulic pump, a closed hydraulic loop with pressure protection and charge-flow support, hydraulic motors driving both the front and rear axles, a finite-mass tractor body, four tire--soil contacts, and an implement that applies a physical tillage load to the tractor.
Hydraulic pressure and flow must transmit power from the engine through the pump and motors to the driven wheels;
physical_paths: Hydraulic pressure and flow must transmit power from the engine through the pump and motors to the driven wheels; prescribed vehicle motion, replayed output trajectories, or mechanically disconnected hydraulic signals are not valid.

modes_and_events: Build a physically causal tractor model for steady tillage with a hydrostatic continuously variable transmission.

The model must include an engine or governed prime mover, a variable-displacement hydraulic pump, a closed hydraulic loop with pressure protection and charge-flow support, hydraulic motors driving both the front and rear axles, a finite-mass tractor body, four tire--soil contacts, and an implement that applies a physical tillage load to the tractor.

Across the declared range, the tractor must move forward stably, both axles must receive physically consistent drive effort, pressures and flows must remain finite and bounded by the protection network, and changes in pump displacement, implement depth, and soil properties must causally affect drivetrain effort and vehicle motion.
